consensus_findings.description: The new validation still accepts partial reviewer evidence. validate_binding permits an empty reviewers list or reviewer objects missing vendor and agent_id. With a successful vendor result, zero blocking findings, and a matching head SHA, such a stored verdict passes the predicate and can be reused and merged because independence_violation finds no reviewer to check. A fresh review whose successful vendor omits agent_id can likewise produce a binding that passes despite an unverified same-vendor identity. The new tests cover missing reviewers, but not empty or incomplete entries.

Nit: the cheap path binds with author=None, so its binding carries an all-null author. It validates and is only ever reached under a policy waiver, so it cannot authorize a merge on its own; noted for completeness.
